defects.summary: False fatal banner: not_ready (normal SDK lifecycle) was treated as fatal and mapped to the persistent error banner, which never cleared when the device reconnected.
defects.fix: player.js: not_ready clears deviceId only (no notifyError); new onReady(cb) fired on SDK ready. main.js: onReady resets status to ready + updateBanners() unless premium-denied; ensurePlayer() calls updateBanners() on all exit paths.

defects.summary: prime() left the track playing (immediate pause lost before stream start); playClip() could run away when getCurrentState() returned null (poll never reached targetMs).
defects.fix: player.js: prime() awaits ensurePaused() (poll ~100ms up to 1200ms for paused === false, pause(), then verify paused === true with <=6 bounded retries, each retrying pause() so unreadable state can never be left playing). playClip() calls bestEffortActivate() and sets state.failsafeId = setTimeout(stop, targetMs + 600), cleared inside stop().

defects.summary: Game 1 album cover was recognizable before the guess (.cover--hidden opacity 0.22 / blur 6px).
defects.fix: styles.css: .cover--hidden opacity 0 / blur 24px (transitions kept, .cover--revealed untouched). clip-game.js: neutral alt 'Portada del album' while hidden; revealCover() sets the real alt.
